name: delegate
description: Delegate a task to a specialist agent. Use this when the user's request requires specialized expertise (research, expense tracking, etc.). Provide the specialist's name and a clear task description. How long to wait for the specialist is set by the runtime — do not pass a timeout. If the result reason is already_in_flight, that specialist is still working in this conversation: tell the user the request is queued, and do not call delegate for them again.

outputs.question: string?
outputs.in_flight: boolean? (true when reason is already_in_flight — no second run was started)
outputs.reason: string? (timeout, blocked, specialist_decline, already_delivered, already_in_flight, or a specialist failure reason)
outputs.delegate_event_id: string? (in-flight or timed-out delegation's agent.task id)
outputs.open_handle_age_ms: number? (ms since the already_in_flight row was written; a running claim starts at dispatch, a promoted pending handle keeps that time)
outputs.handle_status: string? (running or pending, on an already_in_flight result)
outputs.handle_expires_at: string? (ISO time the already_in_flight row stops blocking, before the sweep's lag)
